authorization.scope: 实际比较问题四方案1—3；方案4不运行

research_scope.initialization: all strategies start 2025-01-01 00:00 at 6000 kWh; the confirmed Q1 C04 order initializes Jan 1; January is retained separately and produces each strategy's Feb 1 state

branches.Q4-2: midnight plan only; no 06/12/18 order revision
branches.Q4-3: midnight original order plus revisions at 06/12/18 for unexecuted intervals; settlement relative to midnight order

common_model.q4_2_supply: existing Q2 separate forecasts: 4 matching weekdays for load, 7 recent days for PV, 28-day 0.70 net-demand error quantile with 0.70 daily decay and 4-hour groups, 48-hour LP
common_model.q4_3_supply: existing Q3 fused PV forecast and matching-weekday load, 28-day 0.60 net-demand error quantile with 0.70 daily decay and 3-hour groups, updates at 00/06/12/18
common_model.battery: charge and discharge efficiencies each 0.90; 1200--10800 kWh internal inventory; 5000 kW charge/discharge power
common_model.actual_execution: actual load/PV and actual price are revealed causally; actual shortage after order and battery is emergency purchase at five times actual interval price
common_model.time_mapping: 144 ten-minute intervals per day; source_minute modulo 1440 under the confirmed project convention

price_candidates.P1: median of up to four prior matching weekdays at the same slot, with recent-history/base-profile fallback; at intraday releases add the median observed same-day level residual
price_candidates.P2: rolling 56-day standardized ridge regression, alpha=10, on the known base profile, matching-weekday/recent/lagged prices, calendar, causal supply forecast and observed same-day prefix features; refit every 7 days
price_candidates.P3: rolling 56-day histogram gradient boosting, max_leaf_nodes=15, 100 iterations, learning_rate=0.05, min_samples_leaf=50, same causal features and 7-day refit schedule, seed 2026

secondary: unused ordinary order and unused PV
monthly paired differences and adverse days
storage feasibility and LP primal-dual checks
comparison.selection_boundary: the required 2025 period is used for model-family comparison and is not described as an untouched cross-year test
